question: How is the width of the ritual cloth determined from the divided measure?
premises: The total measure is divided into parts.
One part is used to define the cloth's width.
inference: The width of the cloth is said to be one part of the divided measure.
uncertainties: The total number of parts into which the measure is divided is not stated here.
plain_english: Having divided it into parts, the width of the cloth is said to be one part.
